children: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory extended Interim CEO Allen C. Harper’s service term by six months and awarded him a $130,000 RSU grant.
Offer letter amendment; service term extension and special RSU grant
Extension of his original six-month term of service
Additional six-month term; annual base salary remains $140,000. $130,000 in RSUs vest in six equal monthly installments beginning Jan. 8, 2027, while he continues as Interim CEO.
